label: Over-Planner
suggestion: You set many goals but complete fewer than expected. Apply the Rule of 3: pick your 3 most critical goals and focus only on those today.

label: Efficient Learner
suggestion: You are pacing perfectly. Your completion rate is high and distractions are minimal. Keep up this disciplined routine!

label: Distracted Learner
suggestion: High distraction frequency is significantly lowering your completion rate. Try a strict 25-minute Pomodoro sprint with phone on Do Not Disturb mode.

label: Under-Estimator
suggestion: Your sessions frequently run over planned time. Pad your time estimates by 40% and break goals into smaller milestones.
